mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the receiving and sending parts was most worthwhile: the picture traced a signal along a cell and chemical messengers across the gap to another cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the receiving branches was clear but fairly predictable because their bases already matched the cell bodies.

surprise.text: The finished tissue included supporting cells and fatty fibre coverings that I hadn't built separately; their jobs weren't explained.

arbitrary.text: Nothing I chose felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how these nerve signals connect to the muscles built earlier. This chapter made the signal path clear, though its pairings were mostly straightforward.
